## SpaceX Targets September 15 for Starship Flight 14 and First Orbital Mission

A first orbital mission for Starship is a potentially re-rating event for SPCX; success would validate the full-stack architecture and unlock commercial and defense payload contracts, while a failure or delay would renew questions about program timelines and affect the near-term SPCX sentiment.

- SpaceX has set September 15 as the target date for Starship Flight 14.
- The flight is framed as setting the stage for the rocket's first orbital mission.
